name: Pavillon Faubourg Saint-Germain
positioning: Literary Left Bank hotel and spa in Saint-Germain-des-Pres, set in three conjoined 17th-century buildings where James Joyce and T.S. Eliot once lived
best_for: Literature lovers drawn to the Joyce and Eliot history
Travelers who want a Saint-Germain base slightly removed from the bustle
Guests who want a spa in historic vaulted cellars

facts.text: The hotel is located between the Seine and the Cafe de Flore in Saint-Germain-des-Pres.
The hotel is set within three conjoined buildings, each initially built in the 17th century as noble maisons.
By 1910, T.S. Eliot took up residence in one of the rooms for a time.
The Chevalier Group overhaul was overseen by interior architect Didier Benderli.
Rooms have high ceilings, crown moldings, 70s-style furnishings and parquet floors, each with a slightly different color palette.
Rooms look out over the district's facades and rooftops.
Family rooms accommodate up to 5 people.
The Spa des Pres includes a deep pool with water jets, a fitness room, a meditation and yoga room, two massage cabins and a hammam.
Spa treatments are offered in partnership with CODAGE Paris.
The restaurant, Les Parisiens, is named in homage to James Joyce's book Dubliners.
The Joyce Bar has its own entrance and hosts live jazz music once a month.

highlights.text: James Joyce lived at the hotel's address; in 1920 he came with his wife and two children to finish the manuscript for Ulysses.
The Spa des Pres is set in the vaulted cellars that once housed the Quod Libet cabaret, where Leo Ferre began his career; the steps leading down are classified as a historical monument.
The top-floor Joyce Suite has exposed wood beams, two bathrooms and unobstructed views over the rooftops of Paris.
Books published by Gallimard fill the lounges, from the library to the fireplace salon, and guests can pull from the well-stocked bookshelves of the library lounge.

considerations.text: The spa is in the cellars and has two massage cabins.
The hotel is in Saint-Germain but slightly removed from the neighborhood's bustle.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the exclusive Left Bank location.
